events.publicTitle: A written transfer order names Cragmaw Castle
events.title: A written transfer order names Cragmaw Castle
events.detail: Isolated mock discovery: party searched Iarno’s desk and found a Redbrand transfer record naming Gundren and Cragmaw Castle. This establishes written evidence of an earlier transfer, not current custody or geographic coordinates.
events.playerText: A transfer order names Gundren and Cragmaw Castle. His present condition and exact route remain unknown.
events.source: MOCK first-entry desk search; existing custom transfer record

events.title: The Dendrars released and escorted
events.detail: ISOLATED corrected mock: Mirna,Nars,Nilsa released after cellguards defeated and Ringgo tools23; escorted along cleared marked corridor, ropecrossing and agreednothicpassage toPhandalin. NoGundrenrescue inferred.
events.playerText: Mirna, Nars and Nilsa are safe inPhandalin. Their information offers aThundertreelead.
